note: Ink and ground for each colourway. A mark is one colour, so a colourway is only ever this pair - which is what lets either mark take any of the three.

colourways.name: Slate & Bone
colourways.why: The app's own water blue. Ships as the default and is what the installed icon always is.

colourways.name: Brass & Char
colourways.why: Oiled leather and old tackle. Stands out hardest in a crowded app drawer.

colourways.name: Moss & Sand
colourways.why: Riverbank rather than river. Leaves blue free to mean water everywhere else.
